en.askTitle: Swap in your own city, start date and pay floor and get the same job-search plan, built around roles that can actually hire you
en.runTitle: Guadalajara to a remote design job: a mid-level product designer aiming to start by April 2027

fields.label: Experience and your strongest work
fields.value: 5 years as a mid-level product designer

fields.label: Portfolio
fields.placeholder: e.g. a Figma-based portfolio site with 3 case studies

fields.label: Time you can give each week
Work permission
fields.placeholder: e.g. Mexican citizen, no permit needed

fields.label: Employee or contractor preference
fields.placeholder: e.g. happy to be a contractor if the pay is higher

en.template: Help me plan a remote design job search from {location} for {start}. Use my {experience}, {portfolio}, {time}, {pay}, {permit} and {pref}. Prioritise country eligibility, realistic pay and a weekly plan. Flag questions for an accountant or lawyer. Plan only; do not apply or contact anyone.

phases.title: Check pay benchmarks, Mexican tax and hiring routes, and which jobs are open
phases.note: Salary sources, the tax authority’s own pages, and company career pages
phases.judgment: It corrected an out-of-date tax checklist: the 2026 miscellaneous tax rules, not the old 2024 guidance, now govern annual filing for RESICO income. It also said what it could not confirm: the detailed current RESICO rate table was not recovered, only the published 1%–2.5% band.

phases.title: Keep checking until there are ten postings that truly fit
phases.note: A second round of job checks on company career pages
phases.judgment: It reported that the first round found only five fitting postings, not ten, and kept looking instead of padding the list. It dropped roles that failed on location: a Deel role whose country list left out Mexico, hybrid-only roles at Multiplica and Marathon, and a closed Bitovi vacancy.

phases.title: Put the job evidence into the plan page and the source list
phases.judgment: Pay and fit caveats went into the plan rather than being smoothed over: Wikimedia’s published US$116,633–181,243 is a US-only band, not Mexico pay, and doola’s wording does not name Mexico, so the plan says to ask first.

phases.title: Check every citation, completeness, and desktop and phone layout

workers: Searched public job boards for real remote product-design openings and checked each one on the employer’s own page for location rules, level and pay
Read Mexico’s tax authority pages on contractor tax regimes, annual filing and VAT on foreign clients, plus how employer-of-record hiring works
Went through eight companies’ current career pages to see which design roles were really open to someone in Mexico, then added three more verified roles

zh.askTitle: 把所在城市、入职时间和薪资底线换成你的，就能得到同样的远程求职计划，只盯真正能雇你的岗位
zh.runTitle: 从瓜达拉哈拉找远程设计工作：5 年经验的中级产品设计师，目标 2027 年 4 月前入职

fields.label: 作品集
fields.placeholder: 例如：一个放了 3 个案例的 Figma 作品集网站

fields.label: 工作许可
fields.placeholder: 例如：墨西哥公民，不需要工作许可

fields.label: 雇员或承包偏好
fields.placeholder: 例如：薪酬更高的话可以接受承包

zh.template: 请帮我规划从{location}寻找远程设计工作，目标{start}。结合我的{experience}、{portfolio}、{time}、{pay}、{permit}及{pref}，优先筛选允许所在国家的岗位、合理薪酬和每周行动。提醒我哪些问题要问会计或律师。只做计划，不投递、不联系招聘方。

phases.title: 查薪资参考、墨西哥的税务和雇佣方式，以及有哪些岗位在招
phases.note: 薪资来源、墨西哥税务机关官网、各公司招聘页
phases.judgment: 它纠正了一份过时的报税清单：RESICO 收入的年度申报现在以 2026 年税务综合规定为准，不再沿用 2024 年的旧说明。它还写明了没能确认的部分：现行 RESICO 的详细税率表没有找到，只核实了公布过的 1%–2.5% 区间。

phases.title: 继续核实，直到凑够十个真正合适的岗位
phases.note: 再查一轮各公司的招聘页
phases.judgment: 第一轮只找到五个合适岗位，不是十个，它如实说了，并继续找，没有拿不合格的凑数。因地点不符被剔除的有：Deel 一个国家名单里没有墨西哥的岗位、Multiplica 和 Marathon 的混合办公岗位，以及已经关闭的 Bitovi 岗位。

phases.title: 把岗位证据整合进计划页和来源清单
phases.judgment: 薪资和匹配度的疑点都写进了计划，没有抹平：Wikimedia 公布的 11.6 万至 18.1 万美元是仅限美国的区间，不是墨西哥的薪酬；doola 的招聘文字没有点名墨西哥，计划里写明要先问清楚。

phases.title: 核对每条引用、完整性，以及电脑和手机上的显示

workers: 在公开招聘网站上找真实的远程产品设计岗位，并到雇主自己的页面核对地点要求、经验年限和薪资
读墨西哥税务机关的官网页面：承包人的税务方案、年度申报、对外国客户收款的增值税，以及通过代雇用机构入职是怎么回事
逐个查了八家公司当前的招聘页，看设计岗位是否真的向住在墨西哥的人开放，之后又补充核实了三个岗位
